name: Ishihara Yukari
source:
Born in Kanagawa. She has an older brother. A genius. She can do whatever she is made to do skillfully, but since she is disinterested, she often plays the supporting role.

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2016/02/root-letter-dev-diary-discusses-key-elements]Gematsu[/url]]
